text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Did you feel like you weren't 
really in the zone?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, now. Don't look so down.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's hang out again sometime! ...Besides, 
it gives me the perfect excuse to slack 
off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
